definitions.name: diagnostic uses packaged synthetic all-tier cases without cloud credentials and keeps observations separate from claims
an already resident model is reported honestly and Auto profile still checks all classifier tiers

assertions.expression: assert.ok(!('confirmed_model' in report.rows[0]), 'No Claude model executed')

definitions.name: unrelated resident models are never evicted to manufacture a cold or warm measurement
a newly resident unrelated model stops the diagnostic before another inference
missing, cloud, and unsupported local installations fail before sending synthetic tasks
invalid settings, other backends and keep-alive zero are rejected without requests

assertions.expression: assert.fail('Invalid configuration must not make requests')

definitions.name: production timeout zero is preserved while initial preparation keeps its separate bound

assertions.expression: assert.notEqual(inference[0].signal, controller.signal, 'Preparation has its own 60s budget')

assert.ok(report.rows.every(row => row.source === 'ollama' && row.latency_ms >= 4),
    'Unlimited measured calls complete beyond the neighboring finite-deadline fixture')

definitions.name: runtime timeout fallback fails the gate and cannot pass as a Sonnet classification

assertions.expression: assert.ok(report.rows.every(row => row.source === 'fallback' && row.classifier_error === 'timeout' && row.classified_tier === undefined && row.tier === 'sonnet'))

definitions.name: wrong labels fail agreement and coverage even when every local call succeeds
failed preparation returns safe error metadata and skips measured cases
invalid and oversized residency metadata is bounded and prevents evaluation
caller cancellation propagates before I/O and during timeout-disabled runtime evaluation

assertions.expression: assert.rejects(runLocalDiagnostic(config, { signal: before.signal, fetchImpl: () => assert.fail('already cancelled') }), /cancelled-before/)

definitions.name: cancelling a stalled residency read releases its reader and sends no task text
progress callback throws or rejected promises cannot prevent diagnostic completion

assert.ok(tiers.includes(selected), 'Each synthetic task survived the actual state extraction')
